sentences.text: No, it is not compliant to only mention the bank’s online schedule of penal charges in the sanction letter and loan documents, because the quantum and reason for penal charges must be clearly disclosed upfront in the loan agreement and KFS as applicable, in addition to being displayed on the UCB’s website, and a reference to the website schedule in the sanction letter and loan agreement shall not suffice.
These directions apply to new retail and MSME term loans sanctioned on or after October 1, 2024, and the case facts give a sanction date of 2026-03-15 for a Tier 3 UCB.
